title: The Synthetic Data Vault
summary: The founding SDV paper. Introduces generative modeling of an entire multi-table relational database via recursive conditional parameter aggregation, and evaluates it by having data scientists solve predictive tasks on synthetic versus real data with no statistically significant difference in outcome.

title: The Synthetic Data Vault: Generative Modeling for Relational Databases
summary: The MEng thesis behind the DSAA paper, developing the first generative modeling technique capable of covering an entire relational database rather than a single flat table.

title: SDV: An Open Source Library for Synthetic Data Generation
summary: Lays out the software abstractions and architecture for building generative models over database systems, and introduces reversible data transforms (later the RDT library) as the mechanism that makes such modeling tractable.

title: Synthesizing Tabular Data using Generative Adversarial Networks (TGAN)
summary: The first tabular GAN from the group, using an LSTM to generate columns sequentially for mixed discrete and continuous tables. Direct predecessor of CTGAN.

title: Modeling Tabular Data using Conditional GAN
summary: Introduces CTGAN and TVAE, together with mode-specific normalization and training-by-sampling to handle imbalanced categorical columns and multi-modal continuous columns. The most cited artifact in the ecosystem and the standard baseline for tabular synthesis.

title: Learning Vine Copula Models For Synthetic Data Generation
summary: Casts vine copula structure selection as a reinforcement learning problem, learning tree structures that capture hierarchical dependence in tabular data better than greedy heuristics.

title: Synthesizing Tabular Data using Conditional GAN
summary: The thesis version of CTGAN, with a broader benchmark against contemporary tabular generative models; the benchmarking apparatus became SDGym.

title: Synthetic data assessment based on model improvement
summary: Frameworks for assessing synthetic data quality by measuring whether it improves downstream models, rather than by statistical similarity alone.

title: Sequential Models in the Synthetic Data Vault
summary: Documents the PAR algorithm used for multi-sequence time series in SDV: context columns are modeled separately from the sequence body, allowing generation of new entities with their own coherent sequences.

title: CENTS: Generating synthetic electricity consumption time series for rare and unseen scenarios
summary: Generates high-fidelity synthetic household electricity consumption traces, including rare and unobserved scenarios, for power-grid planning and simulation.

title: Copula Graphical Models for Wind Resource Estimation
summary: Pre-SDV copula work: estimates wind speed at candidate turbine sites from correlated reference sites using copula graphical models. The copula machinery here is the ancestor of the Copulas library and GaussianCopulaSynthesizer.

title: sdv-dev/SDV
summary: The main SDV library: single-table, multi-table and sequential synthesizers, metadata, constraints, sampling and evaluation. Business Source License 1.1 since v0.18.0 (MIT through v0.17.2), each release reverting to MIT four years after its own release date. Distributed on PyPI as `sdv` and on conda-forge.

title: sdv-dev/CTGAN
summary: Reference implementation of CTGAN and TVAE, used both standalone and as the deep-learning backend of SDV's single-table synthesizers.

title: sdv-dev/RDT
summary: Reversible Data Transforms: the preprocessing layer that converts arbitrary column types into numeric form for modeling and inverts the transformation afterwards, including anonymization transformers such as AnonymizedFaker and RegexGenerator.

title: sdv-dev/SDMetrics
summary: Vendor-agnostic evaluation library for synthetic data: diagnostic and quality reports, column-wise and pairwise similarity metrics, privacy metrics such as DisclosureProtection, and visualization utilities. The only library in the ecosystem still under an OSI-approved license (MIT).

title: sdv-dev/SDGym
summary: Benchmarking harness that runs synthesizers (SDV's and third-party ones) across public datasets and reports quality, runtime and memory. The substrate for most head-to-head comparisons in the tabular synthesis literature.

title: sdv-dev/Copulas
summary: Multivariate copula models (Gaussian and vine) with univariate marginal fitting. Backs GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, the default statistical model in SDV.

title: sdv-dev/DeepEcho
summary: Mixed-type multivariate time-series generation, implementing the PAR model that backs SDV's PARSynthesizer.

title: sdv-dev/TGAN
summary: The original LSTM-based tabular GAN, superseded by CTGAN and dormant since 2022. Retained under MIT; of historical and citation interest.

title: SDV Community documentation
summary: Installation and scope of the free tier: pip or conda install, Python 3.9-3.14, Business Source License, and the surrounding standalone libraries (RDT, SDMetrics, SDGym).

title: SDV Enterprise documentation
summary: The licensed on-prem SDK: scalable multi-table synthesizers, deeper metadata detection, and enterprise deployment. Installed through `sdv-installer` with a username and license key rather than from public PyPI.

title: SDV Community vs Enterprise feature comparison
summary: Feature-by-feature table across Community, Enterprise and each bundle, covering synthesizers, transformers, constraints, integrations and evaluation. The most precise public statement of where the open/commercial line falls.

title: SDV Bundle: Constraint-Augmented Generation (CAG)
summary: Add-on that applies complex business logic across multiple tables during generation, auto-detects constraints from data, and supports programmable constraints beyond the predefined set.

title: SDV Bundle: Differential Privacy
summary: DPGC and DPGCFlex synthesizers plus DP noise transformers, and an empirical procedure for verifying the differential privacy of any synthesizer.

title: SDV Bundle: AI Connectors
summary: Direct database integration: schema and key discovery, training-data import, and export of synthetic database clones. Supports AlloyDB, BigQuery, MSSQL, Oracle, PostgreSQL and Spanner.

title: SDV Bundle: Targeted Sampling
summary: Multi-table conditional sampling and extrapolation beyond the ranges seen in training data, for constructing specific test or stress scenarios.

title: SDV Bundle: XSynthesizers
summary: Enhanced models and transformers: XGC (flexible-shape copula modeling), SegmentSynthesizer for highly segmented data, BootstrapSynthesizer for very small tables, plus ECDF and 100+ distribution normalizers.

title: SDV Agent (MCP server)
summary: Beta chat interface to SDV Enterprise delivered as an MCP server, exposing metadata detection, training, sampling and evaluation as tools an LLM front-end can call.

title: Meet the Synthetic Data Vault
summary: The introductory post on the DataCebo blog: why synthetic data matters, how SDV came out of MIT's Data to AI Lab, and what the library ecosystem covers.

title: Improving machine learning for synthetic data
summary: How SDV's modeling layer changed in response to user feedback after open-sourcing in 2018: more model choices, sequential data support, and encoding of business logic.

title: Differential Privacy for Synthetic Data (Part II): Trust-but-Verify
summary: Second of a two-part series: how to empirically verify that a differentially private synthesizer actually delivers its claimed guarantee, walked through in SDV.

title: From fake data to synthetic data (software testing)
summary: Argues why rule-based fake data is insufficient for realistic test data and what machine learning adds. Used by DataCebo as the software-testing solution page.

title: Simulating scenarios with the flights synthesizer
summary: Worked example of generating scenario data for AI models and agents from a flights dataset.

title: Synthetic label balancing
summary: When generating synthetic minority-class rows helps an imbalanced classification problem, and when it does not.

title: Synthetic clones for ML / sharing data
summary: Using a synthetic clone of a dataset for external collaboration, and what happens to model performance when training on it.

title: How ING Belgium uses SDV Enterprise for 100x test coverage
summary: ING Belgium replaced manual construction of test payments with SDV Enterprise: roughly 10,000 synthetic SEPA payments in two minutes versus ten payments per hour by hand, reported as about 100x the scenario coverage in a tenth of the time.

title: UCLA credit-card fraud detection with synthetic case data
summary: A UCLA team used an SDV model to generate additional fraud examples consistent with historical fraud, reporting roughly a 20x reduction in false negatives for the detector.

title: MAPFRE: improving homeowner insurance fraud detection with synthetic data
summary: Insurer MAPFRE reports a 31 percent improvement in detection of homeowner insurance fraud using synthetic data.

title: Synthetic data for anti-money-laundering detection
summary: Banks use synthetic data to develop money-laundering detection without exposing customer records.

title: Introducing AI Connectors
summary: Launch of the database-integration bundle: automatic schema discovery and end-to-end import/export of synthetic database clones.

title: Introducing Constraint-Augmented Generation (CAG)
summary: Launch of CAG, framing business rules as constraints enforced during sampling so that generated data is valid by construction.

title: Launching differentially private synthesizers in SDV
summary: Launch of the DP bundle, adding formal differential privacy guarantees to SDV model training.

title: sdv.dev - The Synthetic Data Vault project site
summary: Project landing site: library directory, community statistics and download counts, and the blog.

title: DataCebo Forum
summary: Official support forum for SDV Community and Enterprise; the main public record of user problems and usage patterns since the Slack community wound down.
